name: Dujella–Peral · Z/2 × Z/4 · Diophantine Triple Rank 4
description: The Dujella–Peral one-parameter Diophantine-triple family with torsion Z/2Z × Z/4Z and exact generic rank 4.
generic_rank_status: The paper proves exact generic rank 4 and that the four displayed points generate the free Mordell-Weil group. Rank Hunter exact-certifies those directions at t=15.
